audit.whatIsWrong: Six of the seven level-chart rows disagree with their own why-text and with the packet. The page reads Skill/Akali/Akali/Skill/Skill/Akali/Akali, while whys[] say Akali edges L1, you catch her at 2, you slam her at 3, you keep the edge at 4-5, she flips it at 6, you reclaim on first item, she assassinates late.
audit.why: The packet levelChart is exactly what the whys describe: Akali, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Akali, Illaoi, Akali. The side/win fields were never updated to match the prose, so the page renders 'Akali wins Level 2' next to text explaining how you win Level 2.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Akali, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Akali, Illaoi, Akali — proposed as one atomic group with phases[N].side and win[N] paired.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike named her dashes but never the execute, and never gave a real cooldown to plan around.
audit.why: Perfect Execution (R) carries the execute flag: the recast kills below a health threshold, so an HP number decides the fight, not the bar. Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s — the longest cooldown in her kit and the only true window she has.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is her spike, not yours; your spikes are Harsh Lesson at 2-3 and the first item, both taken while Shroud is on its 16-20s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Twilight Shroud as a hard counter to your whole kit. The decisive interaction — that it is not — was never stated.
audit.why: Test of Spirit rips out a separate spirit unit, and Riot's text says spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take to the original target. Shroud makes Akali untargetable; it does nothing to the spirit. Tentacles keep swinging at the spirit and the echo still lands on her inside the smoke.
audit.corrected: Land E first. If she shrouds, keep slamming the spirit — the damage reaches her through the smoke.

audit.whatIsWrong: Akali is referred to as 'he'/'him' in tradeGood, the trading breakdown, the report, the feeding block and the don'ts.
audit.why: Template text was stamped in without a gender pass; it reads as machine-generated to a paying user.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in place, same length.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Whiff E on her dashes' but its body is generic filler with no numbers.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s and Shuriken Flip is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s — near-identical cooldowns, so throwing E into her flip loses the trade of cooldowns outright.
audit.corrected: Body now names the 16s and tells you to throw after the flip, not into it.

notes: packet.suspectNames flags whys[4] 'Perfect Execution's' as a probable wrong name — false positive: Perfect Execution is correct and the flag is only reacting to the possessive apostrophe. Unresolved contradiction left alone because it is a champion-level call, not a fact: diff is the enum 'EVEN' while diffRating is 8.5/10, report[14] says 'Hard matchup', tone is the red #ff5d6c, and the Emerald+ win rate is 52.79% over 1739 games in Illaoi's favour. Those four cannot all be right. Also, per the description-beats-flag rule I did not use the 'grounding' or 'untargetable' flags on Leap of Faith: Riot's text says only that it damages nearby enemies and spawns a tentacle per champion hit. The mirror audit (akali__illaoi) reached the same conclusion.
